command: WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`JSON.stringify({text:document.body.innerText,buttons:[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].map(x=>({text:x.innerText.trim(),disabled:x.disabled})).filter(x=>x.text),inputs:[...document.querySelectorAll("input")].map(x=>({type:x.type,value:x.value}))})`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){console.log("TIME_SETUP="+m.result.result.value);const d=JSON.parse(m.result.result.value);if(!d.text.includes("Shelly Plug S Gen3"))process.exit(2);const b=d.buttons.find(x=>/^Install/.test(x.text));if(!b||b.disabled)process.exit(3);ws.close();}}'
